digest.headline: Nasdaq futures surged on artificial intelligence optimism while German inflation cooled to 2.8% and the Japanese yen slid toward 160.

lede.b: Nasdaq futures jumped 1.91% before the market opened. This means investors are trading contracts that track the future price of shares in big technology companies, which are climbing because people feel very positive about artificial intelligence. At the same time, German inflation slowed down to 2.8%. Inflation is the rate at which the general prices of goods and services go up over time. In Japan, the yen slid toward 160 against the US dollar, which is a ten-week low. The US dollar strengthened because strong price data made traders think US interest rates might rise. Interest rates are the cost of borrowing money, set by central banks.
lede.i: Nasdaq futures climbed 1.91% in pre-market trading as artificial intelligence optimism lifted major technology stocks. German inflation slowed to 2.8% in October, driven by falling energy costs in Europe's largest economy. Meanwhile, the Japanese yen slid toward 160 against the US dollar, marking a ten-week low. Strong US price data boosted bets on Federal Reserve rate hikes, which strengthened the dollar and accelerated retail selling of the yen.
lede.a: Nasdaq futures advanced 1.91% in pre-market sessions as artificial intelligence optimism propelled technology equities like CoreWeave and Anthropic. German inflation printed at 2.8% in October, matching expectations and reflecting downward pressure from headline energy costs. Simultaneously, the Japanese yen depreciated toward 160 against the US dollar. Robust US price metrics drove expectations of tighter Federal Reserve policy, widening interest rate differentials and prompting aggressive retail liquidation of the Japanese currency.

United States of America.label: United States
United States of America.sub: Nasdaq futures surge and US inflation data sparks volatility

stories.t: Nasdaq Futures Surge as AI Optimism Lifts Major Tech Stocks
stories.b: Nasdaq futures jumped by 1.91% in pre-market trading. High-profile technology stocks rose during the session. CoreWeave and Anthropic fueled optimism around artificial intelligence.
stories.i: Nasdaq futures surged 1.91% in pre-market trading as major technology stocks advanced. CoreWeave and Anthropic fueled optimism across the artificial intelligence sector. This momentum lifted pre-market sentiment for index tracking contracts.
stories.a: Nasdaq futures rallied 1.91% in pre-market trading, driven by broad appreciation in high-profile technology equities. CoreWeave and Anthropic catalysed sentiment tied to artificial intelligence infrastructure demand. The resulting futures extension reflects concentrated positioning in large-cap growth proxies.

stories.t: Officials Flag US Inflation Report as Markets Brace for Volatility
stories.b: Recent inflation data in the United States reminded investors to expect price swings. Goolsbee called the latest report troubling. Market participants braced for increased volatility following the release.
stories.i: US inflation figures served as a reminder for investors to expect heightened volatility. Goolsbee characterized the latest report as troubling. Market participants adjusted risk parameters following the data release.
stories.a: The latest US inflation print reinforced expectations for sustained market volatility. Goolsbee described the data release as troubling, prompting immediate repricing of near-term rate probabilities. The reaction underscores market sensitivity to incoming macro prints relative to terminal rate assumptions.

politics.b: Economic officials monitor price data releases closely. Federal Reserve figures comment on public economic reports. Markets react directly to these official statements.
politics.i: Federal Reserve officials analyze incoming price data to gauge policy paths. Goolsbee evaluated the recent consumer metrics publicly. Market participants incorporate these official assessments into valuation models.
politics.a: Federal Reserve officials evaluate incoming price metrics to calibrate forward guidance. Public commentary from regional presidents like Goolsbee provides qualitative overlay to quantitative prints. Market participants parse these statements to refine expectations for upcoming monetary policy decisions.

timeline: Nasdaq futures surge 1.91% in pre-market trading.
Goolsbee calls the US inflation report troubling.

United Kingdom.label: United Kingdom
United Kingdom.sub: UK inflation expectations and commodity-driven FTSE gains

stories.t: Pound and Prices
stories.b: British prices are expected to stay high through 2027. This keeps the pound steady. High prices mean things cost more over time. Central banks try to control this.
stories.i: Persistent inflation projections for 2027 underpin the pound sterling. Analysts at Deutsche Bank anticipate consumer price measures will tick higher in October. Markets continually adjust currency valuations based on these domestic price trajectories.
stories.a: Stubborn inflation prints slated through 2027 anchor the sterling narrative against shifting Federal Reserve dynamics. Deutsche Bank forecasts an upward trajectory for October metrics, reinforcing the domestic monetary tightening path. Traders price persistent input pressures directly into currency forward curves.

stories.t: FTSE Climbs
stories.b: The FTSE 100 stock index went up. Companies like BP, Shell, and mining firms gained value. This happened because raw materials became more expensive.
stories.i: The FTSE 100 index advanced as heavyweight energy producers BP and Shell alongside various miners rallied. Stronger commodity prices propelled these natural resource equities higher. Positive sentiment also spilled over from rising US futures.
stories.a: Equities on the FTSE 100 outperformed as robust commodity benchmarks catalyzed a broad rally across integrated energy majors like BP and Shell alongside diversified miners. Positive US equity futures provided an auxiliary tailwind for the London large-cap index.

politics.b: Government leaders face questions on how rising living costs affect citizens.
politics.i: Policymakers monitor sticky consumer price indices as fiscal pressures mount.
politics.a: Parliamentary scrutiny intensifies around persistent input cost growth and treasury revenue projections.

timeline: Deutsche Bank forecasts an upward move for UK inflation in October.
FTSE 100 rises due to gains in BP, Shell, and mining stocks.

Germany.label: Germany
Germany.sub: German inflation cools to 2.8% and DAX touches record highs

stories.t: German Inflation Rate Slows Down in October
stories.b: German inflation measures how fast the general price of goods and services goes up over time. Government data showed that this rate cooled down to 2.8% in October. This slowdown happened mostly because energy prices became cheaper. People watch this number to understand the changing cost of living.
stories.i: German inflation slowed to 2.8% in October, matching expectations. Falling energy costs drove the deceleration in the headline consumer price index. This easing gives insight into domestic price pressures within Europe's largest economy.
stories.a: German October inflation printed at 2.8%, aligning with consensus forecasts. The contraction was primarily a function of softer energy prints working through the headline basket. This downward trajectory eases some immediate pressure on domestic purchasing power parity metrics.

stories.t: DAX Nears Record Highs Amid Technology and AI Optimism
stories.b: The DAX is an index, which is a group of major company shares tracked together to show how the stock market is doing. The DAX climbed to an indication of 26,526 points. Optimism around artificial intelligence and companies like Siemens helped lift the market near record highs. Traders also bought tokenised versions of the DAX 40 on a platform called 360x.
stories.i: The DAX index traded at an indication of 26,526 points, flirting with record highs. Technology gains and corporate earnings from firms like Siemens fueled the upward momentum. Enthusiasm surrounding artificial intelligence and CoreWeave helped offset ongoing interest rate worries. Additionally, a tokenised version of the DAX 40 became available on 360x.
stories.a: The DAX printed an indication of 26,526 points, testing historical highs. Equity valuations expanded as technology tailwinds and corporate earnings from Siemens and CoreWeave offset prevailing monetary policy headwinds. Secondary market structures also evolved with the launch of a tokenised DAX 40 product on 360x.

stories.t: Bundesbank Chief Forecasts Faster Economic Growth
stories.b: The Bundesbank is the central bank of Germany, acting as the main public institution that manages the country's money and banking system. The head of the Bundesbank stated that economic growth in Germany is set to pick up speed in the fourth quarter. This prediction points to an economic expansion before the end of the year.
stories.i: The Bundesbank chief reported that German economic growth is set to accelerate in the fourth quarter. This projection points to an improvement in domestic economic output for the final three months of the year. The central bank statement offers a positive signal on national productivity.
stories.a: The Bundesbank president indicated that German economic growth will accelerate through the fourth quarter. This upward revision implies stronger macro momentum heading into the year-end close. Output metrics across the industrial and service sectors will need to validate this acceleration.

politics.b: German financial officials and central bank leaders focused on economic growth targets and slowing price increases.
politics.i: German policymakers monitored macroeconomic indicators as inflation softened to 2.8% and growth forecasts picked up for the fourth quarter.
politics.a: German institutional authorities digested the interaction between retreating headline inflation prints and the Bundesbank's projected fourth-quarter growth acceleration.

timeline: German inflation for October is confirmed at 2.8% as energy costs ease.
Bundesbank chief announces that German economic growth will accelerate in the fourth quarter.
DAX trades near record highs at an indication of 26,526 points.

Japan.label: Japan
Japan.sub: Japanese yen weakens towards 160 against the US dollar

stories.t: Japanese Yen Slides Near 160 Against US Dollar
stories.b: The Japanese yen is a form of money used in Japan. It dropped in value toward 160 per dollar. This is the lowest point the currency has hit in ten weeks. Traders sold more yen because people expect higher borrowing costs in America. US price data showed that inflation is still a factor.
stories.i: The Japanese yen slid toward 160 against the US dollar. This level marks a ten-week low for the currency. Strong US price data boosted bets on Federal Reserve rate hikes, strengthening the dollar. Bank of America noted that retail selling of the yen increased.
stories.a: The Japanese yen depreciated toward the 160 threshold against the greenback, marking a ten-week low. Hot US consumer price data drove up Federal Reserve rate-hike expectations, widening yield differentials. Bank of America observed that retail carry trade liquidations and yen selling intensified, though foreign inflows partially offset the outflow.

stories.t: Tokyo Stocks Rise Following Share Buybacks
stories.b: Tokyo stock markets went up today. Companies bought back their own shares. This happened after worries about artificial intelligence cooled down. Citi warned that if stocks drop further, the yen might get stronger.
stories.i: Tokyo stocks climbed as companies executed share buybacks. Market anxiety regarding artificial intelligence eased during the session. Citi warned that further corrections in Japanese equities could trigger additional yen strengthening.
stories.a: Tokyo equities advanced on corporate buybacks following a dissipation of artificial intelligence sector headwinds. Citi analysts highlighted that further corrections in the Japanese stock market carry the risk of forcing unexpected yen appreciation. Valuations remain sensitive to foreign equity flows.

politics.b: There is no major political news coming from Japan today.
politics.i: No significant political updates were reported for Japan today.
politics.a: No relevant political developments or policy announcements were published for Japan today.

timeline: Tokyo stocks rise on buybacks after AI concerns ease

China.label: China
China.sub: Export growth, robot startup pressures, and currency moves

stories.t: October Exports Exceed Forecasts
stories.b: Chinese exports grew by 35.2% in October. This beat the expected 33.5% prediction. Trade figures measure goods sent to buyers in other nations.
stories.i: China exports rose by 35.2% year-on-year in October. This print outpaced the consensus expectation of 33.5%.
stories.a: October exports expanded at 35.2% year-on-year, printing above the 33.5% market expectation. Trade data points to external demand resilience despite persistent currency headwinds.

stories.t: Robot Startups Face Financial Stress
stories.b: Chinese robot startup companies face potential bankruptcies. Total investment in these firms is falling. Company valuations are dropping across the sector.
stories.i: Robot startups in China encounter growing bankruptcy risks. Venture investment into the sector has contracted alongside declining company valuations.
stories.a: Chinese robotics startups confront systemic liquidations as primary funding dries up. Valuation markdowns across early-stage developers reflect a severe venture capital pullback.

politics.b: Records show a university linked to the Chinese military bought restricted computer chips from Nvidia. The chips are named H200 models. The purchase happened despite a trade blacklist imposed by the United States.
politics.i: A university connected to the People's Liberation Army acquired restricted Nvidia H200 chips. Procurement records verify the purchase occurred despite official US trade blacklists.
politics.a: PLA-affiliated academic institutions bypassed US export controls to secure restricted Nvidia H200 hardware. Transaction logs confirm procurement channels remained active despite federal blacklisting.

timeline: Chinese yuan moves to 6.7191 against the US dollar.
Changan launches the Lumin PLUS electric vehicle with a starting price of 49,900 yuan.

India.label: India
India.sub: Sensex surges and rupee rises on foreign inflows

stories.t: Sensex Jumps as Foreign Investors Return
stories.b: A stock market index tracks the value of a group of companies. The Sensex is a major Indian stock index. It jumped 1,142 points to reach an eight-month high. Foreign institutional investors brought money back into the market. Crude oil prices stayed soft.
stories.i: The Sensex index jumped 1,142 points to reach an eight-month high. Foreign institutional investors returned to purchase domestic equities. Lower crude oil prices supported broader market sentiment. The Nifty index reclaimed the 25,350 level.
stories.a: The benchmark Sensex advanced 1,142 points to print an eight-month high. Foreign portfolio flows catalyzed the rally alongside benign crude oil valuations. The Nifty reclaimed 25,350 while multiple NSE 500 constituents touched new highs. Equity momentum absorbed hawkish Federal Reserve rate expectations.

stories.t: Indian Rupee Extends Rally Against US Dollar
stories.b: The Indian rupee is the official currency of India. It rose by 7 paise against the US dollar. The exchange rate reached 93.70 per dollar. Foreign money inflows helped support the currency.
stories.i: The Indian rupee appreciated by 7 paise to trade at 93.70 against the US dollar. Foreign equity inflows provided a buffer for the local currency. The domestic unit outperformed most of its Asian peers. Continued foreign buying offset hawkish policy bets from overseas.
stories.a: The Indian rupee gained 7 paise to print at 93.70 against the US dollar. Foreign portfolio inflows outpaced regional capital flight pressures. The currency outperformed most Asian peers despite hawkish Federal Reserve pricing. Softer oil imports restricted current account drag.

politics.b: The Reserve Bank of India reported daily money market volumes. Total transactions in the overnight segment reached 7,37,804.31 crore rupees. Call money trades accounted for 14,551.04 crore rupees of that total. Triparty repo transactions recorded 5,39,199.30 crore rupees.
politics.i: The Reserve Bank of India published daily money market operational data. Total overnight segment volume reached 7,37,804.31 crore rupees with a weighted average rate of 5.50%. Call money volume registered 14,551.04 crore rupees at a 5.59% weighted average rate. Triparty repo transactions totaled 5,39,199.30 crore rupees at a 5.47% weighted average rate.
politics.a: The Reserve Bank of India released money market operational data for November 09, 2026. Overnight segment volume printed at 7,37,804.31 crore rupees with a weighted average rate of 5.50%. Call money turnover stood at 14,551.04 crore rupees at 5.59%. Triparty repo volumes reached 5,39,199.30 crore rupees at 5.47%, while corporate bond repos cleared 7,550.00 crore rupees at 5.74%.

timeline: Reserve Bank of India recorded overnight money market volume at 7,37,804.31 crore rupees.
Sensex jumped over 1,142 points to reach an eight-month high.

Brazil.label: Brazil
Brazil.sub: Petrobras reports third-quarter earnings and higher spending

stories.t: Petrobras Third-Quarter Profit Rises on Record Output
stories.b: Petrobras is a big oil company. It reported its financial results for the three months ending on September 30. Its profit went up by 21% compared to the previous year. This happened because the company produced a record amount of oil. The company also lifted its production targets.
stories.i: Petrobras reported a 21% rise in third-quarter profit, driven by record production levels. The state-controlled energy producer lifted its output and spending targets for 2026. Higher operational capacity supported accelerated investment despite ongoing market debates.
stories.a: Petrobras posted a 21% year-on-year profit expansion for the quarter ending September 30, underpinned by record output. Management concurrently revised 2026 production guidance upward while accelerating capital expenditure plans. These metrics signal a strategic pivot toward heavy investment despite near-term earnings friction.

stories.t: Earnings Miss Expectations as Spending and Costs Weigh
stories.b: A company's earnings are the money it makes after paying expenses. Petrobras missed what financial analysts expected for its earnings. Its expenses and spending plans increased. Investors were disappointed by the payouts and bigger spending plans.
stories.i: Petrobras missed consensus earnings per share estimates for the third quarter. Increased spending plans and disappointing payouts spooked equity markets. Operating costs and capital outlays weighed on the final results.
stories.a: Petrobras reported a clear earnings miss relative to consensus estimates as expanding operational costs and larger capital expenditure plans compressed margins. Equity markets reacted negatively to the heavier spending trajectory and lower-than-anticipated shareholder distributions. The divergence between record volume and missed profit expectations highlights ongoing cost headwinds.

politics.b: Petrobras is controlled by the government. The company is dealing with a review of tariffs by regulators and local gas disputes.
politics.i: State-controlled Petrobras navigates regulatory friction alongside a tariff review by the ANP, which entered a 15-day pause. Additional pressures include a brewing gas feud and operational deadline disputes.
politics.a: State-controlled Petrobras operates under overlapping regulatory constraints, including an ANP tariff review currently observing a 15-day pause following rejected deadline requests. Concurrently, management faces emerging gas sector disputes alongside ambitious state-directed capital allocation targets.

timeline: The third quarter ended for Petrobras financial reporting.
Petrobras released third-quarter financial results and production data.

Saudi Arabia.label: Saudi Arabia
Saudi Arabia.sub: Aramco facilities hit and crude export prices lowered

stories.t: Missiles strike Riyadh infrastructure
stories.b: Houthi missiles from Yemen reached an Aramco building in Riyadh and the Riyadh airport. Saudi Arabia faced these strikes after launching its own raids. Ian Bremmer called this defense issue a very serious problem for the kingdom. Ansarallah announced the attacks on November 10, 2026.
stories.i: Houthi missiles targeted an Aramco administrative building and the Riyadh airport following Saudi raids. Ian Bremmer described the kingdom's defense gaps as a very serious problem. Ansarallah claimed responsibility for the strikes on November 10, 2026.
stories.a: Ansarallah targeted an Aramco facility and Riyadh airport via missile strikes in retaliation for Saudi raids. Ian Bremmer noted the persistence of critical air defense vulnerabilities. The strikes occurred on November 10, 2026.

stories.t: Aramco reduces Asian crude pricing
stories.b: Aramco cut its November Arab Light crude price for Asian buyers by $3. This brought the price down to a 6-year low. Aramco Trading and QatarEnergy also offered crude oil via tenders. These events were reported on November 10, 2026.
stories.i: Aramco lowered its November Arab Light official selling price to Asia by $3, reaching a 6-year low. Aramco Trading and QatarEnergy simultaneously offered crude oil via tenders. Documents showing these tenders emerged on November 10, 2026.
stories.a: Aramco reduced its November Arab Light crude pricing for Asian clients by $3 to a 6-year low. Parallel tender offerings of crude oil were issued by Aramco Trading and QatarEnergy. Document disclosures detailing these pricing moves occurred on November 10, 2026.

politics.b: Houthi forces claimed new attacks against Saudi pipelines and Aramco sites. Ian Bremmer noted that the future war deal will be decided between regional powers. These security updates emerged on November 10, 2026.
politics.i: The Houthis claimed fresh strikes on Saudi pipeline infrastructure and Aramco facilities. Ian Bremmer stated that the conflict will ultimately conclude via a deal cut between regional actors. These reports circulated on November 10, 2026.
politics.a: Ansarallah asserted responsibility for fresh strikes targeting Saudi pipeline assets and Aramco installations. Ian Bremmer argued that the eventual resolution of the conflict will be negotiated among regional players. These developments were published on November 10, 2026.

timeline: Houthi forces claim fresh strikes on Saudi pipelines and Aramco sites.
Aramco cuts November Arab Light to Asia by $3 to a 6-year low.

Nigeria.label: Nigeria
Nigeria.sub: Dangote orders, currency moves, and new payment links

stories.t: Dangote Refinery Initial Public Offering Draws Massive Orders
stories.b: An initial public offering is when a private company sells shares to the public for the first time. The Dangote Refinery held one such sale and pulled in $4.1bn in total orders from buyers. This means many investors wanted to buy a piece of the business. The sale attracted a very large amount of money.
stories.i: The Dangote Refinery initial public offering secured $4.1bn in total orders from institutional and retail buyers. Bookrunners captured strong demand during the share-sale process. Capital commitments flowed heavily into the new equity offering.
stories.a: The Dangote Refinery equity placement cleared $4.1bn in order books, signaling robust domestic and international participation. Syndicate desks managed overwhelming demand curves during the book-building phase. Pricing efficiency hinged on deep liquidity allocation from institutional pools.

stories.t: Stanbic IBTC Launches Direct Cross-Border Payment Link for Naira and Yuan
stories.src: The Guardian Nigeria News · Punch Newspapers
stories.b: Stanbic IBTC has built a new computer platform. This system lets people make payments straight between the Nigerian naira and the Chinese yuan. Traders do not need to use US dollars as a middle step anymore. The project aims to make trade between the two countries easier.
stories.i: Stanbic IBTC unveiled a cross-border platform connecting the naira and the yuan. The payment system enables direct bilateral settlements without requiring a bridge currency. Corporate clients gained a direct channel to execute trade transactions between Nigeria and China.
stories.a: Stanbic IBTC deployed a bilateral settlement infrastructure linking the naira and the yuan. The platform bypasses traditional intermediary currencies to reduce friction in Sino-Nigerian trade flows. Transaction costs compressed as liquidity matching occurred directly within the new corridor.

stories.t: Naira Weakens Against the US Dollar Across Markets
stories.src: MarketForces Africa · Daily Post Nigeria · The Trumpet Newspaper Nigeria
stories.b: The Nigerian naira is the official money used in Nigeria. Its value dropped further against the US dollar recently. Official exchange rates slipped close to N1,351 per dollar. At the same time, the parallel market saw the dollar sell for ₦1,430.
stories.i: The naira recorded further depreciation against the US dollar in both official and parallel segments. Official exchange rates weakened toward N1,351 amid persistent selloffs. Parallel market rates touched ₦1,430 per dollar.
stories.a: The naira extended losses against the US dollar as spot market selloffs intensified. Interbank valuations drifted closer to N1,351, reflecting ongoing inflationary pressures and demand imbalances. Parallel market quotes deteriorated toward ₦1,430, widening the premium over official rates.

politics.b: Mele Kyari went to parliament to talk about money missing from NNPCL accounts. Lawmakers questioned him about the N210tr sum. The government watches these public funds closely.
politics.i: Mele Kyari appeared before the legislature regarding missing funds from NNPCL accounts. Lawmakers probed the disappearance of the N210tr figure during the hearing. Parliamentary oversight focused on accountability within the state oil entity.
politics.a: Legislative summons compelled Mele Kyari to testify before parliament concerning the alleged disappearance of N210tr from NNPCL ledgers. Parliamentary committees scrutinized internal financial controls at the state-backed enterprise. The inquiry exposed governance vulnerabilities in national resource management.

timeline: Stanbic IBTC introduced a platform for direct naira-yuan transactions.
The exchange rate dropped near N1,351 per dollar on reported selloffs.
Mele Kyari testified before parliament about N210tr missing from NNPCL.

Australia.label: Australia
Australia.sub: ASX 200 closes higher with tech sector support

stories.t: Australian shares gain ground as technology sector supports market
stories.b: The S&P/ASX 200 index finished the trading session higher with an increase of 0.27%. Technology companies helped drive the market upwards during the day. Traders experienced a challenging session before finishing with modest gains.
stories.i: The S&P/ASX 200 index advanced by 0.27% at the close of trade. Technology shares provided crucial support to keep the broader market rally alive. Market participants navigated a difficult session to secure the positive result.
stories.a: The S&P/ASX 200 closed up 0.27% in an unconvincing session. Technology equities absorbed selling pressure to sustain the ongoing index appreciation. Price action highlighted fragile breadth beneath headline indices.

stories.t: Corporate updates reveal asset adjustments and supply progress across sectors
stories.b: Suncorp Group carried out share buy-back activities during November. Talga Group advanced supply talks with Japanese partners towards a definitive agreement. Lark Distilling recorded domestic sales growth while export distribution into China took longer.
stories.i: Suncorp Group executed capital returns and buy-back operations in November. Talga Group progressed Japanese anode supply discussions toward a formal agreement. Lark Distilling reported higher domestic sales while navigating delayed distribution timelines in China.
stories.a: Suncorp Group progressed its November capital return and buy-back schedule. Talga Group converged on a definitive commercial agreement for Japanese anode supply. Lark Distilling experienced domestic revenue expansion alongside logistical friction in its Chinese distribution channels.

politics.b: No political updates were released today.
politics.i: No political developments were reported in the session.
politics.a: No macroeconomic or fiscal policy releases occurred during the period.

timeline: Suncorp Group reported ongoing buy-back activity and capital returns for November.
